title: Summertime Rendering
label: Quick read (from summaries)
premise: Shinpei Ajiro returns to his home island for the funeral of his childhood friend Ushio, who drowned, and learns that 'Shadows' are copying and killing islanders (to verify). Each time Shinpei dies he loops back in time, and with Ushio's own Shadow and her sister Mio he races to uncover the island's buried god and stop the killings (to verify).
life_message: It holds up perseverance, thinking clearly under pressure and laying down one's life for friends and home.

content.note: Shadows kill and copy people; repeated deaths of the hero (to verify; AniList Gore 72%; likely higher).
Body-snatcher horror and time-loop tension (to verify; likely higher).

Suicide flagged in content signals; Shinpei's deaths drive the loop (to verify).
